title: AssetLiabilityRules
accountingModel: Double-entry event-driven ledger where a ledger posting must balance debits and credits.
classificationPrinciple: Asset/liability classification is a value-and-obligation classification layer and does not by itself establish legal title, accounting treatment, or jurisdictional status.

rules.preventNegativeBalance: where the applicable account/contract policy requires it

rulesOfInterpretation: Accounting equality is an implementation accounting invariant, not a replacement for the constitutional value model.
A liability classification does not automatically establish legal debt.
Full-cost accounting is preferred for economic measurement.
Asset and liability state must remain traceable to evidence and source records.
